name: mice
description:
Protein expression levels of 77 proteins measured in the nuclear fraction of cortex from control and Down syndrome mice (Ts65Dn).

First column indicates mouse id.
For each mouse 15 measurements were registered.
Last four columns indicate: Genotype (control or trisomy), Treatment (memantine or saline), Behavior (context-shock (C/S) or shock-context (S/C)) and the class of mice according to the three features (c-CS-s, c-CS-m, c-SC-s, c-SC-m, c-SC-s, t-CS-s, t-CS-m, t-SC-s, t-SC-m, t-SC-s ).

These data are a subset of those used in Ahmed et al PLoS One. 2015 10(3):e0119491.
creator: Clara Higuera, Katheleen J. Gardiner, Krzysztof J. Cios
citation: Higuera, Clara; Gardiner, Katheleen J.; J. Cios, Krzysztof (2015). Protein expression levels of 77 proteins from Control and Down Syndrome mice. figshare. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.1421985.v1
